material.head: Wave 2 turning up from its zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 3 to Jun 1 (+62%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−13% to −20%), on lighter volume, with the Jan 20 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−29%); a close over the wave-1 high (+14%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

against.head: Weekly: a pullback that is not done
against.text: The pullback from the Nov 3, 2025 high is not done: it fell in five waves, only wave A and selling volume is rising. A wave 2 usually unfolds in three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the May 1, 2023–Nov 3, 2025 advance (−29% to −46%).
against.learn: A real wave 2 takes three waves and time, on lighter volume. Too shallow, too quick, one straight leg or rising selling says it has further to go.
